propositions: sign_manifest compares store-wide git HEAD before/after collect() instead of subject-generation, causing false invalidation under unrelated concurrent writes
under_lock_check's locked_head != expected_after disjunct fires on every lock-wait completion because HEAD only moves via commits under this lock, making it anti-correlated to lock acquisition
tracker_head_sha classifies another writer's index-only staged entries (normal locked add→commit footprint) as store-read-failure, consuming the 3-attempt retry budget

the documented recovery tool sign-review permanently starves on tickets with PASS verdict but failed attestation persistence because the fence requires 5–7s store quiescence while median inter-commit gap is 3s and rebar's own enrichment queue commits every ~3.3–5.8s

PlanReviewGeneration docstring and bug 790c AC-1 contract signing to survive unrelated concurrent writes, but sign_manifest enforces store-wide HEAD stability instead, unachievable under prescribed concurrency
